key_finding: Most state-legislature root domains do NOT host a queryable press-release feed. The state-expansion phase will pivot to per-caucus and per-member subdomains. Only NY Senate (Drupal), NY Assembly Speaker (server-rendered single page), CA Senate per-senator subdomains (unwrapped Drupal Views), FL Senate Publications (table), FL House Speaker (Bootstrap list), and WA Senate Dems (WP-JSON) provide directly scrapeable feeds at central URLs. None of the tested sites required JavaScript to render listings — every working feed is server-rendered. The principal blockers are WAF rules (Akamai on nysenate.gov), TLS quirks (nyassembly.gov), and missing-feed architecture (most others).
